senses.gloss: m., pl. עִיקּוּלֵי, (עֲקַל) עִקּ׳ curves, small bays.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 97a">Keth. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>איגלאי … בע׳ הוו קיימי</he> it turned out that the ship (carrying provisions) was waiting in the bays (until the high water would subside, and it could go to harbor).

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 34b:5">Ab. Zar. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>התם ע׳ ופשורי איכא</he> there (along the coast from Tyre to Accho) are bays (formed by protruding rocks) and shallow waters caused by melting snows.
